Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

This session reached the attempt cap with 8 incorrect submissions; no test output was confirmed. The demonstrations strongly suggest the ray mechanics below, but the test-specific combination/offset rule was not solved. Do not retain the older false claim that this test was solved.

Dots in the left band paint rowwise from c0 up to the dot, changing dot 5 to 4. The right band counterpart is filled with 5 for rows corresponding to active marker lanes.

Demo 8 shows multiple markers in one band; each marker lane paints from its edge toward the marker, while the opposite band is filled across for active corresponding lanes.
